nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field and let $\alpha \in K$ be a nonzero algebraic integer that is not a root of unity. Let $d'$ be the number of distinct values of the argument $\arg \sigma(\alpha)$ as $\sigma$ ranges over the ring homomorphisms $K \to \mathbb{C}$. Then the house of $\alpha$, the maximum of $|\sigma(\alpha)|$ over these $\sigma$, is at least $2^{1/(4d')}$.
nodes.title: Dimitrov's lower bound for the house of an algebraic integer
